evidence.curator_note: Eq 8.16, p.149. GENERIC scheme (leaving group R undefined; no m/z or % printed). The precursor is a beta-hydroxy ketone drawn as its molecular ion n-ionized at the carbonyl oxygen: the book prints '+.' on the carbonyl O and draws the enol product ion with '+.' ON THE OXYGEN ('H-O+.'), so charge and odd electron are localized on that O throughout and the SMILES carries O+ with one radical electron in both precursor (=[O+:2]) and enol ion ([O+:2] two-coordinate) (conventions B, C). This record is branch (a): rearrangement of the HYDROXYL H (the favored path per the text -- 'the keto-product stability in Equation 8.16 favors rearrangement of the hydroxyl-H'), which yields the more stable KETO neutral acetaldehyde (CH3CH=O, dHf -1.7 eV printed under it). A six-membered transition state [O2=C1-C4-C5-O6-H8] delivers the O-H hydrogen (map 8) to the carbonyl O, the Calpha-Cbeta bond (C4-C5) cleaves, and the freed carbinol oxygen (O6) closes to the aldehyde C5=O6. ARC COUNT: the book draws 0 electron arc(s) -- the rearrangement is denoted only by the 'rH' label over the reaction arrow and by the drawn six-membered TS geometry; NO curved arrows/fishhooks are printed. The three moves encoded here are the complete balanced electron flow implied by 'rH', written as a concerted 6-electron retro-ene: move <1> O6-H8 sigma -> forming O2-H8 bond; move <2> C1=O2 pi -> forming enol C1=C4 pi; move <3> C4-C5 sigma -> forming aldehyde C5=O6 pi. In this O-localized resonance form the +. radical is a spectator on O2 (no per-atom radical change), matching the '+.' the book draws on the enol oxygen; the same reaction can also be drawn stepwise with fishhooks and a migrating radical. dHf values printed (-1.7 eV keto / -1.3 eV enol) are neutral-product thermochemistry, NOT m/z or intensity. Instantiated R = CH3 (4-hydroxypentan-2-one, M+. = C5H10O2, m/z 102.0675) so every atom is concrete; the enol ion is CH3-C(O+.H)=CH2 (C3H6O+., computed m/z 58.0413) -- a curator instantiation value, not a book-printed number.

This McLafferty-type hydroxyl-H rearrangement has no cross-linked Rule.fromDFS encoding, so the electron flow is curator-derived from the printed scheme and is NOT verified against any MOD rule.
